question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'fact'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fact **means a thing that is known or proven to be true.

 
 
• Example- He blatantly ignored some historical **facts**​ while writing that book.
 
 
 
• Since the point being tried to be made is a statement that is supposedly true, '**fact' **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A** Story **means an account of real or imaginary people told for entertainment.

 
 
• Example- Jumanji is a **story** of adventure and thrill.
 
 
 
• The** term **means a word or phrase used to describe a thing or to express a concept, especially in a particular branch or field of study.
 
 
• Example- The scientific **term** for human beings is Homosapiens.
 
 
 
• **Myth **means a traditional story concerning the early history of people or explaining a natural phenomenon involving supernatural beings or events.
 
 
• Example- He found the ancient Celtic **myths** too fascinating.
